name: Haeundae Beach
desc: Korea's most famous sand. Zero won to watch the sunrise with cup ramyeon while the whole city sleeps behind you.

name: Gamcheon Culture Village
desc: A hillside of candy-colored houses and alley art. Get lost on purpose — the wandering is free and so are the views.

name: Jagalchi Fish Market
desc: Auntie-run fish stalls the size of a small nation. Come for the chaos, stay pretending you'll splurge on king crab someday.

name: Haedong Yonggungsa Temple
desc: A temple perched right on the sea rocks. Waves crash, lanterns sway, wallet stays closed.

name: Gwangalli Beach & Gwangan Bridge
desc: The diamond bridge lights up at night like it knows you're watching. Best free light show in Busan.

name: Busan Tower
desc: Old-school tower above Nampo-dong. A few bucks buys you the whole glittering port at your feet.

name: Taejongdae Park
desc: Cliffs, pines, and a lighthouse at the edge of Korea. Entry: free. Feeling tiny in a good way: included.

name: Beomeosa Temple
desc: A 1,300-year-old mountain temple where the city noise finally shuts up. Free peace, bring your own questions.

name: Songdo Marine Cable Car
desc: Glass-floor cabins gliding over open sea. Save it for a someday flex — window seat over the waves.

name: Gukje Market
desc: A post-war market maze — vintage everything, street toast, and hotteok worth burning your mouth for.
